home.heroTitlePart1: Global Supply Chain AI Empowerment Platform
home.heroTagline: Empowering Local Resources · Connecting Global Markets
home.galleryText0:
Once, traditional linear supply chains ran quietly,
seemingly solid — yet deeply fragile beneath the surface.
home.galleryText1:
Geopolitical conflicts, extreme weather, trade barriers...
Global supply chains face an unprecedented polycrisis.
home.galleryText2:
A single node failure
can trigger a supply chain storm that sweeps the globe.
home.galleryText3Title: Facing the unknown storm — how do we break through?
home.galleryText3Sub: The answer, perhaps, lies deep within the data.
home.aiDesc: Transforming global supply chains from passive, fragmented, and fragile systems into intelligent networks that are predictable, reconfigurable, and resilient.
home.capMatchingDesc: AI-powered multi-dimensional analysis of procurement needs and supplier capacity, with bidirectional matching and scoring. Buyers and suppliers discover and connect directly on one platform — no more blind sourcing.
home.capComplianceDesc: Real-time sanctions list screening, multi-layer beneficial ownership tracing, and automated litigation and compliance record aggregation. Generate due diligence reports in minutes and screen counterparty risk with a single click.
home.capDeliveryDesc: End-to-end transparent tracking of contracts, logistics, and settlements with automatic key-node attestation. Smart fulfillment monitoring reduces delivery delays and default risk, ensuring every transaction is traceable.
home.capRiskDesc: 24/7 global scanning of geopolitical conflicts, tariff policies, and extreme weather — risk events automatically mapped to your suppliers and shipping routes. Early warnings before impact, with alternative plans delivered in real time.
home.capDataDesc: Real-time aggregation and quantitative analysis of platform-wide transaction and risk data. Every decision is data-backed. Knowledge resides in the platform, not in individual minds — experience becomes reusable and transferable.
home.ctaTitle: Join the Global Supply Chain AI Empowerment Platform

home.globalSourcingDesc: An AI algorithm engine that senses weather, geopolitics, tariffs, logistics, and market dynamics in real time — delivering intelligent, end-to-end decision-making from sourcing to delivery, enabling cost reduction, efficiency, and resilience amid uncertainty.

decisionCenter.heroSub: AI fuses full-spectrum data for optimal decisions in seconds
decisionCenter.sectionDesc: Fusing signals, predicting change, simulating contingencies, and automating response — a complete decision loop for supply chain resilience.
decisionCenter.capSignalDesc: Direct connections to global geopolitical, weather radar, port satellite, and financial market data sources — building a second-by-second synced supply chain risk panorama where black swans have nowhere to hide.
decisionCenter.capPredictDesc: Deep temporal models and causal inference predict demand volatility, freight rate trends, and supply bottlenecks 7–90 days in advance — shifting enterprises from reactive firefighting to proactive positioning.
decisionCenter.capSandboxDesc: Multi-scenario stress testing and supply chain simulation — tariff spikes, port closures, supplier bankruptcies. One click to simulate impact propagation paths and optimal response strategies.
decisionCenter.capCollaborateDesc: Decision recommendations automatically dispatched to procurement, logistics, finance, and compliance teams. Task loop closed with real-time execution feedback — forming a continuously optimizing decision flywheel.
decisionCenter.loopSub: A four-step intelligent closed loop — from insight to recommendation with zero latency
decisionCenter.stepPerceiveDesc: Real-time access to 10,000+ global data sources across geopolitics, weather, logistics, tariffs, and finance
decisionCenter.stepAnalyzeDesc: 100B-parameter industry LLM for deep reasoning — identifies risk patterns and opportunity windows in seconds
decisionCenter.stepDecideDesc: Multi-objective Pareto-optimal solution derivation — quantifying cost, risk, and return for every decision
decisionCenter.stepExecuteDesc: Decisions auto-dispatched to ERP, TMS, SRM — task loop with closed-loop tracking and real-time deviation correction
decisionCenter.perceiveItem1Desc: Integrates internal systems (ERP, WMS) with external signals — weather, geopolitics, and more — for a unified operational view.
decisionCenter.perceiveItem2Desc: 24/7 real-time monitoring ensures business system data stays perfectly aligned with the physical world.
decisionCenter.analyzeItem1Desc: When supply chain disruptions occur, the AI engine cuts through the noise to pinpoint the exact affected nodes.
decisionCenter.analyzeItem2Desc: Real-time assessment of order default risk from delays, quantifying both direct and indirect additional costs.
decisionCenter.decideItem1Desc: Under time pressure, generates multiple response plans in seconds and compares their trade-offs side by side.
decisionCenter.decideItem2Desc: One-click evaluation of backup suppliers, alternative routes, and warehouse network feasibility for decision support.
decisionCenter.executeItem1Desc: Deep integration with core enterprise systems (ERP, WMS) — instructions flow directly to execution, eliminating manual errors.
decisionCenter.executeItem2Desc: Tracks execution progress and outcomes post-dispatch, forming a complete sense-to-respond loop.
decisionCenter.aiCommandSub: Natural language interaction — AI analyzes and decides in real time. Confirm to execute.
decisionCenter.aiQuery: Show Tier 1 suppliers in Asia-Pacific with supply disruption risk in the next 30 days
decisionCenter.aiAnswer: 3 high-risk suppliers identified: TSMC (earthquake probability ↑), Samsung (strike risk), Murata (raw material shortage). Recommend activating contingency plan B.

smartProcurement.heroSub: AI across the full chain: Sourcing → Inquiry → Comparison → Contracting
smartProcurement.coreDataViewDesc: Breaking down internal data silos with direct connections to global commercial databases and customs data. A real-time knowledge graph of tens of millions of suppliers and products provides 24/7 insights into multi-region market dynamics, FX fluctuations, commodity price trends, and geopolitical risks — ensuring every procurement decision is built on absolute information advantage.
smartProcurement.coreAIEngineDesc: Powered by a 10-billion-parameter LLM fine-tuned for supply chain scenarios. It not only accurately interprets complex procurement needs but also performs deep learning and inference on massive historical datasets. From multi-dimensional cost breakdowns to forward price trend forecasting, the AI engine delivers intelligent decision support that surpasses traditional human expertise — dramatically shortening response cycles.
smartProcurement.coreRiskBlockDesc: Upgrading risk management from reactive remediation to proactive prevention. The system monitors global supplier sentiment, financial health, and macro black-swan events 24/7. Upon detecting potential supply disruption or default risk, it triggers multi-level alerts within seconds and automatically matches and generates optimal alternatives from the backup pool — ensuring supply chains never break.
smartProcurement.coreSupplierCollabDesc: Reinventing how enterprises interact with suppliers. Multi-language RFP/RFQ auto-generation with precision point-to-point distribution — every supplier response, quote, and delivery commitment is aggregated in real time for multi-dimensional comparison. Fully digital audit trails eliminate information asymmetry and build a transparent, efficient, traceable next-generation procurement ecosystem.
smartProcurement.aiStoryTitle: The Era of AI-Powered Smart Procurement
smartProcurement.storyMatchingDesc: Leveraging a knowledge graph of tens of millions of suppliers and multi-dimensional qualification cross-verification, the AI engine pinpoints the best candidates in minutes. Mitigating compliance risk at the source, the sourcing process gains both breadth and depth — significantly enhancing supply chain resilience.
smartProcurement.storyInquiryDesc: The system automatically extracts procurement requirements and generates structured, multi-language RFP/RFQ documents with one click. Precision point-to-point distribution and full-process progress tracking enable automated aggregation of supplier feedback — eliminating tedious manual follow-ups.
smartProcurement.storyComparisonDesc: Deep benchmarking against historical prices and macro market indices, with automatic TCO full-dimension cost breakdown. AI intelligently identifies hidden costs and anomalous quotes, deriving and recommending globally optimal procurement solutions under multi-objective constraints of capacity, delivery, and cost.
smartProcurement.storyFulfillmentDesc: Equipped with an advanced NLP semantic engine to automatically review legal terms and potential commercial risks. The system performs 24/7 automated monitoring and intelligent alerts on key contract fulfillment milestones, combined with blockchain tamper-proof attestation to ensure every transaction is secure and reliable.

smartProcurement.sourcingBullet2: Full-dimension automated due diligence: financials, ESG, anti-bribery, sanctions lists
smartProcurement.sourcingBullet3: Real-time global geopolitical risk and trade compliance scanning with proactive anomaly alerts

smartProcurement.comparisonBullet2: Optimal solution derivation under multi-objective constraints of capacity, delivery, and cost
smartProcurement.comparisonBullet3: Risk-appetite-adaptive matching plans with one-click ROI dashboard decisions

smartProcurement.contractBullet2: Smart alerts and automated monitoring of key fulfillment milestones

trustedDelivery.heroTitle: End-to-End Visibility from Loading to Delivery
trustedDelivery.heroSub: AI-powered full-chain tracking — transparent and in control
trustedDelivery.capTrackingDesc: Breaking down information silos between orders, factories, freight forwarders, shipping lines, and customs brokers — unifying multi-source heterogeneous data onto a single global dashboard. From the moment goods leave the factory, every transit node's status, duration, and responsible party is crystal clear. Anomalies are auto-highlighted and traced upstream, precisely identifying affected routes and ports — making full-chain transparency a daily reality.
trustedDelivery.capWarningDesc: The AI engine continuously cross-references planned schedules against actual progress, covering dozens of risk dimensions including port congestion, route disruptions, extreme weather, and geopolitical conflicts. When risk probability exceeds thresholds, the system auto-alerts within minutes while simultaneously generating optimal alternative route plans based on historical data and real-time capacity — preventing incidents before they occur rather than remediating after the fact.
trustedDelivery.capCustomsDesc: NLP semantic engine automatically assists with HS code classification and FTA preferential tariff matching, completing intelligent pre-review of customs declarations before submission. With a built-in tariff policy database covering major global economies and real-time update tracking, coding-error-related fines and cargo holds are no longer a threat. Every cross-border shipment is compliant and documented — customs becomes an accelerator, not a bottleneck.
trustedDelivery.capSettlementDesc: Ocean, air, land, and warehousing — multi-source invoices automatically consolidated onto one platform. AI line-by-line verification against contracted rates and actual charges, precisely identifying discrepancies, missed payments, and duplicate billing. Supporting real-time FX conversion across 30+ major currencies, month-end reconciliation compresses from days of manual work to minutes of automated audit — generating multi-standard financial compliance reports with one click.
trustedDelivery.bbTitle: Turning the Black Box into a White Box
trustedDelivery.bb1Title: Massive blind spots — heavy manual follow-up
trustedDelivery.bb1Desc: Once goods leave the factory gate, they fall into an information black hole — ETA accuracy is typically below 60%. Logistics node status updates are severely delayed, forcing enterprises to invest substantial manpower in repeatedly chasing multi-tier freight forwarders via email and phone, with information arriving fragmented and distorted.
trustedDelivery.wb1Desc: Aggregating data from 100+ major global carriers, ports, airlines, and IoT devices to build a fully visible supply chain digital network. Order, logistics, and warehousing data penetrates seamlessly — enabling fine-grained, global intelligent tracking from loading to delivery.
trustedDelivery.bb2Desc: When port congestion, route disruptions, or extreme weather strike, enterprises only learn of the delays days later. This information lag often leads to exponential increases in demurrage, empty container fees, and other surcharges — or directly disrupts downstream production schedules and delivery commitments.
trustedDelivery.wb2Title: Proactive risk — instant alerts, smart reroute
trustedDelivery.wb2Desc: Deeply integrating global weather radar, geopolitical dynamics, and massive historical logistics data, the system automatically issues alerts 48 hours before a crisis erupts. Once risk probability exceeds thresholds, the AI engine generates multiple alternative plans within seconds — transforming reactive scrambling into proactive control.
trustedDelivery.bb3Title: Error-prone customs — manual entry adds risk
trustedDelivery.bb3Desc: In global trade networks, traditional document processing relies heavily on manual verification and keyboard entry. Faced with diverse and frequently changing customs policies across countries, HS code mismatches or omissions easily occur — leading to heavy fines or legally detained cargo.
trustedDelivery.wb3Desc: Built-in real-time updated tariff and compliance policy database for major global economies, with NLP semantic models automatically completing product classification and FTA tariff calculations. All customs documents undergo deep system quality inspection before formal submission — eliminating clearance obstacles at the source.
trustedDelivery.bb4Desc: Faced with massive cross-currency, multi-party invoices across ocean, air, and warehousing, finance teams spend days each month on manual reconciliation. Inefficient verification not only slows business cadence but also risks missing penalty discrepancies, FX loss exposure, or duplicate payments.
trustedDelivery.wb4Title: RPA audit hub — instant bill reconciliation
trustedDelivery.wb4Desc: The system automatically aggregates full-chain cost listings, with AI performing precise line-by-line verification against contracted rates and actual charges. Seamlessly supporting intelligent FX conversion across 30+ global currencies — dramatically compressing the once-cumbersome month-end financial reconciliation cycle down to minutes.

intel.newsDisclaimer: * Global Intelligence Brief compiled from 2026 public reports for layout and perspective demonstration; click any card to view full content.
intel.news1Title: Black Sea Export Corridor Attacked Again — Russian Drones Strike Three Foreign Merchant Ships
intel.news1Summary: Ukraine's grain and metal export corridor security is in crisis. The attacks may drive up global food prices, with African, Middle Eastern, and Asian importers bearing the brunt.
intel.news2Title: Ukraine's 'Logistics Blockade' Campaign: 15 Russian Refineries Hit This Year
intel.news2Summary: Jan–May Ukrainian strikes hit 15 refineries, with ~40% of Russian refining capacity offline. Fuel rationing in Crimea; Russia has restricted refined product exports.
intel.news3Title: War Risk Repricing: Middle East Conflict Drives Up Marine Insurance — Underwriters Pull Out of the Gulf
intel.news3Summary: Multiple P&I Clubs canceled Gulf war risk coverage within 72 hours. Premiums for Western vessels surged to several percentage points of hull value, with costs cascading across the entire supply chain.
intel.news4Title: Red Sea Crisis Continues: Major Carriers Default to Cape of Good Hope Routing
intel.news4Summary: CMA CGM, Maersk, and others have made the Cape of Good Hope the default Asia-Europe route, adding 10–14 days and ~30% in fuel per voyage, with container surcharges of $500–$1,500.
intel.news5Title: Eastern Europe Land Crossings Disrupted — China-Europe Rail Trains Reroute and Raise Prices
intel.news5Summary: The main corridor transiting Russia-Belarus-Poland continues to be impacted by geopolitical conflict. Land transit times and costs are rising, with enterprises shifting to multi-hub and alternative routing.
intel.news6Title: Panama Canal Maintains Normal Operations — but 2027 Drought Risk Looms
intel.news6Summary: The Canal Authority maintains 38 transits/day with no restrictions for the year, but intensifying El Niño raises the risk of a repeat of 2023's reduction to 22 transits/day during the 2027 dry season.
intel.news7Title: Strait of Hormuz Nearly Closed — 20% of Global Oil Chokepoint Disrupted
intel.news7Summary: Since late February US-Israeli airstrikes on Iran, daily strait transits have plummeted from ~95 to single digits. Brent crude approaching $95; war risk premiums briefly surged more than tenfold.
intel.news8Title: EU CBAM Carbon Border Mechanism Enters Definitive Phase — Importers Must Surrender Carbon Certificates
intel.news8Summary: Effective January 1, imports of steel, cement, aluminum, fertilizer, electricity, and hydrogen require authorized declarant status and carbon certificate surrender. Q1 carbon price: €75.36/tonne.
intel.news9Title: US Section 232 Metal Tariffs Extended to Copper — Up to 50%
intel.news9Summary: Effective April 6, steel, aluminum, copper, and derivatives face full-rate tariffs: primary metals 50%, derivatives 25%, some industrial equipment 15% — reshaping procurement costs and origin strategies.
intel.news10Title: US 10% Universal Tariff in Legal Limbo — Still Being Collected Ahead of July 24 Expiration
intel.news10Summary: The Court of International Trade ruled Section 122 tariffs unlawful, but the Federal Circuit issued a temporary stay. CBP continues normal collection; refunds are not automatic.
intel.news11Title: China Rare Earth Export Controls Looming: November 10 Deadline Approaches
intel.news11Summary: The April 2025 licensing regime on seven medium-heavy rare earth categories remains in effect; the October expanded controls are suspended until November 10. If reinstated, extraterritorial clauses will affect overseas manufactured goods containing Chinese rare earths.
intel.news12Title: US Tightens AI Chip Controls on China — Explicitly Covers Overseas Subsidiaries
intel.news12Summary: Commerce Department clarification: overseas subsidiaries of companies headquartered in China are equally subject to AI chip export restrictions. H200 reviewed case-by-case; Blackwell remains embargoed.
intel.news13Title: US Imposes Tariffs on Imported Pharmaceuticals — Up to 100%
intel.news13Summary: Patented drugs and APIs face tiered tariffs of 20%–100%, taking effect in batches on July 31 and September 29. UK pharmaceuticals at 10%. Reshaping pharmaceutical supply chain strategies.
intel.news14Title: USMCA Joint Review Approaches — July 1 Becomes Critical Date
intel.news14Summary: Under Article 34.7, the joint review launches six years after entry into force. If the three countries fail to jointly confirm, a 10-year sunset mechanism begins — impacting North American supply chains and nearshoring strategies.
